existingProfile.reason: Default JIT tiers and --no-opt produced different NaN bits for identical source and inputs. --jitless was stable across all six cold/warmed probe processes.
existingProfile.throughputPolicy: Performance measurements may use compiled native candidates or separately identified runtime flags. Qualification compares candidate traces against this pinned source profile; measurements alone do not establish equivalence.
existingProfile.scope: Reproducible reference implementation profile, not a claim that ECMAScript specifies NaN sign/payload or that all engine versions produce identical bits.
